title: Information Greenhouse: Optimal Persuasion for Medical Test-Avoiders
abstract: arXiv:2407.02948v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Patients often avoid medical tests because the information they provide, although medically useful, is psychologically painful. This paper studies optimal communication between a doctor and an information-avoidant patient who can refuse testing and treatment. I characterize when optimal communication creates an information greenhouse, a commitment to reward participation with comforting information about the untreated prognosis. When testing is voluntary and the patient is unwilling to be tested under extreme pessimism, an information greenhouse is optimal and takes the form of committed comfort, which provides reassuring information after the test. When the patient can reject the consultation at the outset and the patient's prior belief about the untreated prognosis is intermediate, an information greenhouse is optimal and takes the form of precautionary comfort, which provides reassuring information before the test. translated_title: 信息温室：针对医疗检查回避者的最优说服
translated_abstract: 患者常常回避医疗检查，因为检查所提供的信息虽然在医学上有用，却在心理上令人痛苦。本文研究了医生与一位可以拒绝检查和治疗的、回避信息的患者之间的最优沟通问题。作者刻画了最优沟通在何种条件下会创造出一种“信息温室”——即一种承诺，通过提供关于未治疗预后的令人宽慰的信息来奖励患者的参与。当检查是自愿的、且患者在极度悲观的情况下不愿接受检查时，信息温室是最优的，其形式为“承诺式安慰”，即在检查之后提供令人安心的信息。当患者一开始就可以拒绝咨询、且患者对未治疗预后的先验信念处于中间水平时，信息温室是最优的，其形式为“预防式安慰”，即在检查之前提供令人安心的信息。在所有其他情形……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文刻画了医生与回避信息的患者之间最优沟通在何时形成“信息温室”——即通过承诺在检查前或检查后提供关于未治疗预后的宽慰信息来激励患者接受检查，并区分出“承诺式安慰”与“预防式安慰”两种最优形式。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when optimal doctor-patient communication creates an "information greenhouse"—a commitment to reward test participation with comforting information about the untreated prognosis—taking the form of either "committed comfort" (reassurance after testing) or "precautionary comfort" (reassurance before testing).
